pages.title: The integrated instrument research family
text: An integrated instrument could bring controlled observation, environmental monitoring, incubation-related functions and material handling into a coordinated laboratory workstation. Its purpose would be to make a longer biological process observable and reproducible. The appropriate physical arrangement remains open and should follow the selected assays, service requirements and risk assessment.
## Integration creates new responsibilities

Imaging a plate at one endpoint is different from maintaining conditions over time. A time-series instrument must control or measure relevant environmental variables, preserve time origins, detect interruptions and distinguish instrument faults from biological changes. Added motion or liquid handling introduces further requirements for identity, containment, cleaning and mechanical safety.
## Keep assay boundaries intact

A direct MIC method, a disk diffusion reader and a research growth model are distinct functions even if they share an instrument housing. Each needs its own eligibility rules, controls and evidence. A research atmosphere or specialized optical mode should not be enabled within a clinical workflow merely because the hardware can support it.

The development decision is therefore modular: select a useful combination, define the interfaces and demonstrate the integrated behaviour. A broad catalogue describes possibilities across the portfolio, not a requirement to install every module in one device.

pages.title: The imaging and microscopy family
text: The imaging family extends from whole-plate observation to selected microscopic or spectroscopic investigations. Different questions demand different fields of view, spatial resolution, contrast mechanisms and temporal sampling. A single camera arrangement is unlikely to provide the best measurement for every scale.
## Choose the scale from the question

Whole-plate imaging supports spatial context, zone measurements and colony distribution. Higher magnification can support cell-level or microcolony research, but reduces the area observed at one time and increases the burden of focusing, positioning and data handling. Spectral and phase-sensitive approaches may reveal information that ordinary colour images do not, while introducing their own calibration and interpretation requirements.
## Preserve context across scales

A high-magnification field should retain its position within the parent specimen or plate. A reviewer needs to know whether the field was selected manually, by a prespecified sampling pattern or by an algorithm attracted to an unusual feature. Otherwise, a striking image can be mistaken for a representative observation.

Published single-cell AST research illustrates that specialized imaging can support short assay windows in selected experimental settings. It does not show that whole-plate imaging automatically has the same timing or clinical scope. [R11] The proposed imaging family should therefore qualify each scale and workflow on its own terms, with shared provenance rather than interchangeable claims.

pages.title: The automation and robotics family
text: Automation should remove a demonstrated source of variation or workload. Candidate functions include plate loading, indexing, scheduled observation, barcode association and transfer between qualified modules. More advanced liquid handling and robotic workflows belong to separately assessed development tracks.
## Make every physical action accountable

A motion command should have a permitted starting state, a target state, feedback and a defined response when completion is uncertain. The software record should describe what the instrument observed about the action, not merely what it requested. A command to move a plate is not evidence that the plate arrived in the correct position.
## Separate safety from conversational control

Operator assistance may explain a sequence or collect an annotation, but a learned language model should not become the sole authority for safety-critical motion or environmental control. Interlocks, command authorization and deterministic limits should remain effective when the interface or cloud service fails.

The strongest early automation candidate is often the simplest one that makes a repeated operation more consistent. The development sequence should measure operator time, identity integrity, recovery burden and maintenance demand alongside mechanical cycle time. A faster mechanism that creates more ambiguous plate associations would not satisfy the product objective.

pages.title: The research instrumentation family
text: Research instrumentation should support investigators who need reproducible observations and transparent access to data. Its outputs may include raw images, calibrated measurements, temporal features and sensor traces. The value lies in the quality and interpretability of those observations, rather than in assigning a clinical category before the relevant assay has been validated.
## A configurable but bounded environment

Research configurations can expose additional optical modes, sampling schedules and analysis options. Those choices should be versioned and recorded. An investigator should be able to reconstruct the configuration that produced a dataset and distinguish an intentional experimental change from an unrecorded instrument drift.
## Protect comparability

Open access to settings is useful only when changes remain interpretable. For example, an exposure adjustment can alter image intensity without indicating a biological change. A different illumination mode can reveal another feature while breaking direct comparability with the prior series. The research interface should make these transitions explicit.

Partnerships should define who owns observations, who can reuse them, what de-identification is required and which results may be published. Research use is not a blanket exemption from privacy, biosafety or instrument safety responsibilities. A well-designed research product gives investigators the information needed to meet those responsibilities and to evaluate whether its measurements answer their question.
